name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　クルルロボ
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Kururu Robo

description.ja: TVアニメ「ケロロ軍曹」に登場する“クルルロボ”がプラモコレクションにラインナップ。
description.en: “Kururu Robo” that appears in the TV anime “Keroro Sergeant” is now available in the plastic model collection.

description.ja: 左右のクローは開閉可動が可能。
description.en: The left and right claws can be opened and closed.

description.ja: 頭部パーツの差し替えにより、パラボラアンテナの展開状態を再現可能。
description.en: By replacing the head parts, it is possible to reproduce the deployed state of the parabolic antenna.

description.ja: 付属のクルル曹長はソーサーに搭乗可能、クルルロボと共に専用台座でディスプレイ可能。
description.en: The included Sergeant Major Krull can be mounted on a saucer, and can be displayed on a special pedestal along with Krul Robo.
